attribution_assessment.safe_future_wording: Xinhua reported that Israeli authorities turned travelers back at Rafah and suspended humanitarian and commercial shipments from Egypt on November 3. Gaza's crossings authority said the change came without prior notice. Israeli military sources cited by Kan attributed the closure to alleged smuggling and interference by Hamas security personnel; those sources said Kerem Shalom was unaffected. The report does not establish that every Gaza aid crossing closed or that the suspension continued on later dates.
